what_happened: Scene L2/S2, a near-failure: success at 1574, 26 steps before the horizon. Pan (pan_8) grasped at 115 and placed at 311 (stage 0 at 325). Sponge placed at 584 (stage 1 at 620). Stage 2 took 954 steps (p90 385). The gripper reached the faucet at 891 and pushed the lever to 0.327 rad by 928, 82 % of the 0.40 needed. It then moved up and away (932-1150: wall, ceiling, sink from above). It came back at 1157-1198 with a few one-step contacts that did not move the lever, wandered again (~1300-1400), and touched the sponge in the pan (1453-1488, no lift). At 1520-1567 it returned to the lever, and the final push took it from 0.33 to 0.50 at 1574.
self_recovery: Recovered from an incomplete lever push by returning about 640 steps later. This is the same partial-push-then-leave pattern as failures s4 (0.164) and s22 (0.214), but here the policy came back in time.
